entry.title: St. Agatha’s Tower

terrainReference.basis: The native sample at the model footprint center locates the tower and entry stair.

entry.note: Mapped Red Tower way 91447984 and entrance node 3898282959 fix orientation. The modeled stone flight meets the sampled site path and uses a short timber bridge consistent with the custodian’s photograph. PMTiles bridge 35184758581593 represents this approach and is replaced when the model is present. The modeled bridge span uses visual proportions and the surrounding mapped paths remain visible. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
